title: Allotment Watering Roster System
originalRequest: Design and implement an automated coordination system to assign and monitor watering duties for community allotment plots based on plot capacity, crop requirements, and owner availability.
latestMessage: Design and implement an automated coordination system to assign and monitor watering duties for community allotment plots based on plot capacity, crop requirements, and owner availability.

steps.title: Initialize Allotment Database Schema
steps.instruction: Define PostgreSQL tables for plots, gardeners, and daily water allocation metrics.
steps.acceptance: Database migrations run successfully and schema is verified against PostgreSQL v15 database instance.
steps.result: Initial schema design on attempt 1 failed due to unresolved relational foreign key constraints on the gardeners table. Successfully restructured table dependencies and executed migration on attempt 2.

steps.title: Implement Core Roster Generation Algorithm
steps.instruction: Develop the backend scheduling algorithm to allocate watering shifts based on crops' daily moisture requirements.
steps.acceptance: Algorithm generates a conflict-free 7-day watering schedule matrix.
steps.result: Attempt 1 generated uneven distribution patterns with multiple weekend conflicts. Adjusted load balancing constraints on attempt 2 to guarantee equal shift distribution across all available gardeners.

steps.title: Expose Roster REST API Endpoints
steps.instruction: Develop secure endpoints to retrieve and modify the generated watering roster.
steps.acceptance: GET /api/v1/roster and PUT /api/v1/roster/{id} return expected JSON payloads with HTTP 200.
steps.result: Developed endpoints and added controller unit tests. Verification checks passed on attempt 1 with zero test regressions.

steps.title: Integrate Weather Forecast API [BLOCKED]
steps.instruction: Connect roster scheduler to regional meteorological service to dynamically lower watering volume based on forecasted rain. Currently blocked due to delayed approval of API keys from the regional weather bureau.
steps.acceptance: Watering requirements decrease dynamically when forecasted precipitation exceeds 5mm.

steps.title: Configure SMS Notification Gateway [BLOCKED]
steps.instruction: Integrate third-party SMS platform to transmit daily shift notifications to designated gardeners. Currently blocked pending security and privacy compliance review of the external platform API.
steps.acceptance: SMS dispatches successfully 24 hours prior to a gardener's scheduled shift.

steps.title: Integrate Smart Soil Moisture Sensor Feedback [BLOCKED]
steps.instruction: Establish telemetry pipelines to ingest live soil moisture sensor data and override manual schedule allocations. Currently blocked due to supply chain hardware procurement delays for IoT modules.
steps.acceptance: The scheduling algorithm dynamically scales down allocation when moisture readings exceed 75%.

steps.title: Develop Administrator Web Dashboard [IN PROGRESS]
steps.instruction: Create frontend administrative interface to allow manual override and manual swap of gardener shifts.
steps.acceptance: Admins can authenticatedly log in, view the grid layout of the roster, and trigger recalculations.
